sources.title: LTX Video AI Models & Generator | Civitai
sources.snippet: LTX Video (LTXV) is an open-weight video model from Lightricks built around a diffusion transformer tuned for speed — it generates coherent, cinematic clips from a text prompt or a starting image at close to real-time rates. The family spans the light, fast 2B model up to the latest LTX Video 2.3. Generate video right here on Civitai — no GPU, no install.
